current_events: Iran's navy says that an oil tanker caught on fire after hitting a naval mine east of the Strait of Hormuz
The Israeli Air Force strikes a Hezbollah underground facility in Lebanon's Bekaa valley
Two Israeli drones explode in Nabatieh, Lebanon, without causing any injuries
The Houthis fire missiles at King Abdullah Financial District in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, which damage the Public Investment Fund Tower and other buildings but cause no injuries

The Yemeni government's military says it has killed or injured 144 Houthi fighters during recent operations in the Taiz, Marib, and Al-Jawf governorates, and to have repelled an attack in the Tur Al Bahah area
The Houthis say that Saudi-led coalition airstrikes have killed 10 people in Sanaa, Yemen, over the past two days
Gaza's health ministry reports that two people have been killed by recent Israeli attacks and two others died from their wounds over the past day

In Bangladesh, banned Awami League members loot and burn properties in Gopalganj District, including BNP MP Md. Selimuzzaman Mollah's ancestral home, a police station, and a Grameen Bank branch, and vandalise BNP and Jamaat-e-Islami properties. Separately, attackers burn the homes of former politicians Rahim Ullah in Feni District, Shahriar Alam in Rajshahi District and Mahmud Hasan Sumon in Mymensingh District
Border Guard Bangladesh deploys 97 platoons across seven districts, with five more on standby, amid ongoing political violence and labour unrest
Aftermath of the July Uprising

The Joint Organisations Data Initiative reports that Saudi Arabia's oil exports rose in September to their highest level since the outbreak of the war in February, despite the Houthi attacks on Red Sea ports and infrastructure
Economic impact of the 2026 Iran war

Across Bangladesh, 341 garment factories remain closed amid ongoing minimum wage protests, as police fire tear gas and stun grenades to disperse demonstrators in Ashulia and clear blockades on the Dhaka–Mymensingh Highway in Gazipur, while Bangladesh Nationalist Party members take up positions along highway areas in Sreepur and authorities tighten security at Kashimpur Central Jail
2026 Bangladesh garment workers protests

Senegalese president Bassirou Diomaye Faye enacts the revised 2026 budget by decree after parliament rejected it, seeking to advance a proposed US$2.2 billion International Monetary Fund loan programme aimed at addressing the country's debt

The Philippines and Chile sign a free trade agreement as part of the 33rd Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation Economic Leaders' Meeting in Shenzhen, China, marking the former's first such agreement with a Latin American country

Chinese leader Xi Jinping, Russian president Vladimir Putin, and United States president Donald Trump hold their first trilateral meeting in Shenzhen during the APEC summit and issue a joint declaration addressing nuclear war, petroleum production, and United Nations reform

Somalia expels the ambassador of the United Arab Emirates, saying the country undermined Somalia's sovereignty

An Israeli court extends the detention of Gaza's Kamal Edwan hospital director Hussam Abu Safiya by six months

The International Court of Justice rules that Myanmar has committed genocide against the Rohingya people

Incumbent president of El Salvador Nayib Bukele presents his presidential candidacy to the Supreme Electoral Court seeking registration ahead of the 2027 elections. He is running for a third presidential term that will last six years
2027 Salvadoran presidential election

The State Great Khural accepts the resignation of Mongolian president Ukhnaagiin Khürelsükh. The chamber's chairman, Sandagiin Byambatsogt, assumes the acting presidency until a new election is held within four months
